findings.title: Race-test evidence is a cached result, not a fresh race run
findings.message: The log `portable-race.txt` records `ok example.com/vellum/ui (cached)`. A cached Go test result replays an earlier run. It does not show that the race detector ran against the code at this commit. The `native-race.txt` log has the same problem for several packages (gallery, platform-smoke, platformio). The `ui/focus.go` changes are in this commit, so a cached pass is weak evidence for the focus race claims. The empty `native-vet.txt` also cannot show that vet was actually run.
findings.suggestion: Re-run with `-count=1` (for example `go test -race -count=1 ./ui` and `cd drivers/cogent && go test -race -count=1 ./...`). Regenerate the logs and add the commit hash and the command to them.

findings.title: Table paging ignores SetViewport error and does not clamp the upper bound
findings.message: The table page closure clamps only the lower bound, unlike `accessibilityTreePage`, which clamps both bounds. The SetViewport error is discarded. If SetViewport rejects a start whose window extends past Len, paging "next" onto the last partial page silently does nothing and the trailing rows are unreachable through accessibility. The failure is also not reported.
findings.suggestion: Clamp next to max(0, length-count) before calling SetViewport, as the tree pager does. Handle the returned error by returning false from the handler or reporting it.

findings.title: Tree row press both selects and toggles expansion
findings.message: The single "press" action on a tree row both selects the row and toggles its expansion when it has children. A screen-reader user who only wants to select an expanded node will collapse it, and one who wants to expand a node cannot do so without also changing selection. The row's `expanded` state is exposed but there are no separate expand/collapse actions. Errors from Select and Toggle are also ignored, and `row.HasChildren` is a stale snapshot captured when the nodes were built.
findings.suggestion: Make "press" select only, and add distinct "expand" and "collapse" actions that call Toggle when the current state differs. Re-read HasChildren and Expanded from the model inside the handler, and check any returned errors.

finding.title: Report acknowledges an unresolved currentRenderWindow race while claiming race-suite acceptance
finding.message: The report opens with an unqualified claim that the native race suite and backend screen-cache regressions pass. It then says a known `currentRenderWindow` data race found in integrated docking is not yet covered by final evidence. The review policy says this race is already fixed by patch18 and covered by a publication/targetScreen test. So the report is either stale or ahead of its evidence. The focused backend command (`TestVellumScreen|TestScreenSnapshot`) and the attached `backend-screen-race.txt` do not show that test, and `native-race.txt` does not cover the integration fixture. An acceptance report that admits a known race with no evidence of the fix is not a reliable gate.
finding.suggestion: Re-run the dynamic docking and multiwindow race suites against the repaired backend, including the `currentRenderWindow` publication test. Add that log, widen the `-run` pattern in the documented command to match, and remove the 'will be updated' caveat. Otherwise state the race as an open gate.
finding.evidence: Integrated dynamic docking additionally reproduced a direct `currentRenderWindow` read racing with its protected setter; final integration evidence will be updated after that backend repair.

finding.title: Geometry JSON entries not type-validated before doubleValue use
finding.message: The geometry payload is checked only for being a 4-element array. The element types are never checked. If an entry is NSNull, NSString, NSArray or NSDictionary, `[rect[0] doubleValue]` can raise an unrecognized-selector exception on the main thread, which crashes the app. The rect is also cached in `state.geometry` and re-read later in vellumAXUpdate with the same unchecked `doubleValue` calls. The snapshot path validates its whole payload up front, but this path does not.
finding.suggestion: Check that each of the four elements is an NSNumber with a finite value before storing the rect in `state.geometry` or applying it to the element. Skip the entry otherwise. Apply the same check where vellumAXUpdate reads cached geometry.

finding.title: Two independent current-window snapshots in runWindow can disagree
finding.message: runWindow takes one current-window snapshot at the top. windowSizingStages() then takes a second, independent snapshot to choose the stage's mains. If focus or publication changes between the two reads, the mains chosen could belong to window A while the later NewWindow-versus-existing-window branch, `fitInWindow` and `ms.push` use window B (or nil). The old code read a single global value; the patch trades a data race for a logical inconsistency.
finding.suggestion: Take one snapshot per operation and pass it through. For example, change windowSizingStages to accept the `current *renderWindow` taken at the top of runWindow, so mains selection and the later branch decisions use the same window.
